Carrier existence is provider-documented; the span and the value policy are project policy. Not an independent review.

Decided 2026-10-06 by the sole maintainer (Milo Kang, milocosmopolitan, repository owner) for credential-evidence#242. Question: Which non-values in the documented Contentful token slots can be asserted as not credentials when token confidentiality is unresolved? Options: Assert placeholders, references, masks, empty values and a token-free preview URL; or assert nothing until confidentiality is settled. Decision: Assert those non-values only. Make no statement about token confidentiality, space IDs or environment IDs. Reason: A value that is not present cannot be a credential whatever the token's status, so the assertion does not depend on the open question. Finalized by the sole maintainer alone under the solo-maintainer period (ADR 0020): not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). Recorded by an AI agent on the owner's explicit instruction of 2026-10-06 (complete redact-secret#1228, #1229 and #1230 before the next release; Cases for these groups are authored maintainer-only, as in Batch 2).
events.dissent: No dissent was raised. The strongest counter-argument, recorded because the rule asks for one: A not-flag Case beside two not-assertable Cases could be read as leaning toward the tokens being non-secret; a placeholder in the access_token slot could hide a literal in some configurations.
events.reversingEvidence: A Contentful statement about the tokens' confidentiality that changes what counts as a value in these slots, or a second maintainer's retro-review that disputes it.
